QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] A Ray of Light Amidst Endless Pain
QuestInfo.0: Ask #p2183002# about the remaining trapped souls.
QuestInfo.1: You were told that if you #beliminate 1 #o9302048##k on the Azwan Battleground, #p2183002# will give you #r3 #t04310036#s#k.

0.0: So many of our poor citizens are still trapped. None of us will ever feel safe and free as long as a single soul remains under her spell. I hope you will understand why we ask you to take on this task...

yes.0: Enter the Azwan Battleground using the portal on the right and defeat #r1 #o9302048##k.

no.0: Who will save these poor people?

1.0: You have eased the suffering of many people today. Thank you.

yes.0: Please return when you can. This will not end until every citizen of Azwan is free again!

quest.0: Can't you hear the cries of her innocent victims? You must try harder!
